gaps.explanation: Cause found, but no fix is written because of the as-printed rule. The whole gap is detail[51], Capital Projects Fund 'Receipts' 145,327 (Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Major Funds, trimmed p8, report p22). The schedule's own arithmetic shows the actual receipts are really 0: Excess (Deficiency) (17,224) = 0 - Disbursements 17,224; Net change (4,911) = (17,224) + Transfers in 12,313; Fund balance 765,190 - 4,911 = 760,279. The variance cell 64,788 on that row repeats the Transit Service Fund ending balance printed just above it. The governmental funds statement (p4) shows no Capital Projects Fund receipts, and statement revenue 7,001,690 = schedule 7,147,017 - 145,327 exactly. This is a misprint in the report, already in report_discrepancies. Under the CLAUDE.md rule, figures stay as printed. If the user decides the misprinted cell should go, remove detail_index 51 (Receipts, 145,327); that closes the gap to 0.
